candidates.name: Sphenoid sinusitis
support_spans: 6 months of progressive right mandibular pain radiating to the zygomatic and mastoid regions
enlargement of the right sphenoid sinus with overdevelopment and opacity of the lateral recess
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and imaging findings are consistent with sphenoid sinusitis.

candidates.name: Trigeminal neuralgia
support_spans: empirical course of prednisone for presumed trigeminal neuralgia
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms were initially thought to be due to trigeminal neuralgia, but treatment was ineffective.

candidates.name: Chronic granulomatous disease
support_spans: persistent inflammation of the sphenoid sinus, skull base, and pterygoid fossa
candidates.why: The patient's persistent inflammation despite treatment suggests a possible chronic granulomatous disease.

candidates.name: Tolosa-Hunt syndrome
support_spans: infiltrating the V2 and V3 trigeminal branches
intracranial extension into the cavernous sinus
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and imaging findings are consistent with Tolosa-Hunt syndrome, a rare disorder characterized by inflammation of the cavernous sinus.

candidates.name: Sphenoid sinus mucocele
support_spans: pyocele, which was marsupialized and drained
candidates.why: The patient's imaging findings and surgical results are consistent with a sphenoid sinus mucocele.

candidates.name: Invasive fungal sinusitis
support_spans: purulent discharge in the sphenoethmoidal recess
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and imaging findings could be consistent with invasive fungal sinusitis, but histopathology was negative.
